features: Two-way audio, VMD, video obscuration detection, x2-x12 digital zoom
Approvals: FCC, UL, CE, CB, KC
notes: Spec sheet and product page state up to 2MP resolution; the A&E spec states recording resolution up to 5MP (5MP, 4MP and 3MP camera types). Max camera resolution left out.
Spec sheet gives weight 13.3 lb; A&E spec gives 6.0 kg (13.2 lb) with 1 HDD. Weight left out.
Spec sheet gives eSATA up to 8 TB per disk; A&E spec gives up to 6 TB per disk.
A&E spec additionally lists 1 BNC (Spot) output; the spec sheet lists 1 HDMI and 1 VGA.
A&E spec gives remote data throughput 3 to 12 Mbps.
Spec sheet and A&E spec give 1 USB 2.0 and 1 USB 3.0 port; the product page lists two USB 2.0 ports.
Product page lists the CR8015ET under Discontinued Products.
